BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, in Daniel's vision of the Ancient of Days: His garment was white as snow, and the hair of His head like pure wool, and His throne was like the fiery flame, and His wheels as burning fire. A flame is the picture of the throne.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the flame is the holiness of God made visible: the throne burns, and the Ancient of Days sits in the fire.
RelatedTopics: God's Holiness; Visions; Majesty of God
